title: Required Minimum Distribution Posting on Fixed Indexed Annuities IRA Contracts
content:
**IRA servicing note — Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities**

**Rule.** For an IRA contract whose owner has reached the required beginning age, Ashgrove posts each year's required minimum distribution from the prior December 31 contract value.

| Element | Reading |
|---|---|
| Contracts | IRA contracts on any Fixed Indexed Annuities tier |
| Owner | has reached the required beginning age |
| Posted by | Ashgrove, once for each year |
| Value used | the contract value on December 31 of the prior year |
| Shown on the record | the calendar year and the required minimum distribution for it |

### Hypothetical reading

For calendar year 2028, the required minimum distribution posted on an eligible IRA contract is figured from the contract value on 31 December 2027, not from the value on a later date or on a contract anniversary.
